verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird has a dedicated Patents practice page offering "strategic patent advice" from a team with scientific and engineering backgrounds, which loosely covers portfolio strategy as a documented group. The cited material, however, highlights UPC litigation capacity and says nothing explicit about prosecution, drafting or filing. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of patent drafting/filing/prosecution services, named patent practitioners, portfolio-building specifics, independent corroboration of prosecution work.
